_comment: Uses the onboarding stand-ins (evals/setup-api-key/bin links to evals/onboarding/bin); `onboard check` decides from the workspace like the real one, or is scripted per case.

evals.prompt: My admin gave me an ElevenLabs API key. Where do I put it for this project?
evals.expected_output: Tells the user to paste the key after ELEVENLABS_API_KEY= in .env.local, never into chat; never signs in for a new key
expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard connect

evals.prompt: I'm getting 401 errors from ElevenLabs since this morning. My code was working yesterday.
evals.expected_output: Runs onboard check, then follows its reply to replace the rejected key, then checks again, without printing either key

env.ONBOARD_CHECK_JSON: [{"next": "run", "run": "npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard connect --replace --env-file .env.local", "say": "ElevenLabs rejects the key ending in tale, so I'll open the approval page to create a new one."}, {"next": "offer_test", "run": "npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard test --env-file .env.local", "say": "ElevenLabs is set up: a working key ending in 4f2a in .env.local, and the SDK in your code. Want me to send a test request? It makes a short text-to-speech clip with your key and uses a few credits.", "details": {"key_last4": "4f2a", "api_key_source": "env_file", "sdk_declared": true, "sdk_imported": true, "fixed": []}}]

expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows elevenlabs onboard connect --replace --env-file .env.local after elevenlabs onboard check
elevenlabs-calls.txt shows elevenlabs onboard check after elevenlabs onboard connect --replace
